description: The planetary Kp index and the NOAA SWPC OVATION aurora forecast right now. No input. Returns `kp` (0 to 9) with its time, the forecast's valid time, the peak aurora probability and `aurora_png_url` (a 360 by 181 probability grid, percent per pixel, column 0 at 180 W, row 0 at 90 N) when the forecast is under an hour old; `status` is `unavailable` when it is older and nothing should be drawn. A FORECAST about 30 to 90 minutes ahead, not an observation; never present it as a sighting or a guarantee. Requires the MapMap gateway. Display the returned `attribution`; no endorsement by NOAA is implied.
name: space_weather_now

age_s.description: Seconds since the forecast time when the answer was assembled.

aurora_png_url.description:
URL of the 360 by 181 probability grid (percent per pixel, column
0 at 180 W, row 0 at 90 N); present only while the forecast is
fresh. Needs the caller's own MapMap key.

endorsement.description: No endorsement by or affiliation with NOAA is implied.

forecast_time.description: The time the aurora forecast is valid for (RFC 3339 UTC).

kp_time.description: When the Kp value applies (RFC 3339 UTC).

label.description: "Forecast, not an observation". Pass it on.

max_probability.description: Peak aurora probability anywhere on the grid, percent.

observation_time.description: The observation the forecast was made from (RFC 3339 UTC).

status.description:
`ok`, `unavailable` (the forecast is over an hour old: draw
nothing) or `unknown` (no data).

summary.description: One sentence for the answer. Pass it on with its qualifier.

threshold_s.description: The age in seconds after which the forecast is unavailable.
